text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, feeling pretty good today♪
I can go *zoooom*!!
choice_data_list: Good work today. Shall we wrap things up here?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
But Turbo can still keep running!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Right now, I feel like I can run waaay more than usual!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
T-That's not true! Not at all!
Look, see? I'm totally full of energy!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Pleeaaaase!!
I just wanna run a little bit moreeeeee!!

Twin Turbo shows no signs of giving up.
What should I do?
choice_data_list: Alright, just a little bit longer, okay?
No. You should get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Really!? You mean it!?
All right, I'm going!!
No sooner had she said that than Twin Turbo dashed off at full speed.
And—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Toryaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Doryaaaaa~~~~~!!
choice_data_list: Hey! Let's wrap it up soon...!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Torya-torya-toryaaaaaaahhhhh!!!!
Uwooooooohhhhhh!!!!

"...Refusing to heed any warnings,
Twin Turbo broke through her limits
and ran all the way through the final stretch."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: *wheeze*, *pant*, *gasp*, *wheeze*...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehehehe...
That felt so refreshing~~~...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: *Yaaaaawn*...
Twin Turbo fell fast asleep right then and there. No matter how many times I called out, she wouldn't wake up, so I carried her in my arms all the way back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"There is much to reflect on regarding today, but...
She wasn't injured, and she seems satisfied herself."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeeeeehhhhh~~~~~~!!
Why can't I?!"
choice_data_list: I don't want you pushing yourself too hard and getting hurt.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: A-An injury!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh... Turbo doesn't want to get hurt either...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, I'll stop.
That's it for today!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
B-But still! I don't wanna go home yet...!!
Turbo still has plenty of energy left!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, I know! Trainer, let's play together!
Let's play hide-and-seek! Hide-and-seek~~♪
